paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy of three different methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—across varying generation temperatures, with the x-axis representing temperature on a linear scale from 0.1 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, and the y-axis showing accuracy on a linear scale from 62.5 to 80.0 in increments of 2.5. The On-policy RL method, represented by a yellow line with triangle markers, begins at an accuracy of approximately 66.5 at a temperature of 0.1, increases to around 72.5 at 0.5, dips to about 67.5 at 0.7, and then rises sharply to a peak of approximately 77.5 at a temperature of 0.8 before declining slightly to around 75.0 at 1.0. The LUFFY method, shown as a red line with star markers, starts at an accuracy of approximately 75.5 at a temperature of 0.1, increases to a peak of around 80.0 at 0.8, and then decreases to about 78.5 at 1.0. The SFT method, depicted by a teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers, begins at an accuracy of approximately 75.5 at a temperature of 0.1, decreases to a low of around 70.0 at 0.5, rises to a peak of approximately 77.5 at 0.6, and then fluctuates, ending at around 74.5 at 1.0.
